title: Columbo
description:
S3 E8 — A Friend in Deed
A man murders his wife and has a friend cover up the act with a burglary, only to have the friend blackmail him into doing the same favor in return.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E1 — An Exercise in Fatality
Lt. Columbo keeps a close watch on a physical-fitness fanatic suspected of murdering his business partner.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E2 — Negative Reaction
A prominent photographer hatches a scheme to cover up his wife's murder with a phony kidnapping plot.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E3 — By Dawn's Early Light
A military-academy commandant murders to protect his career and prevent his school's conversion to a coed junior college.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E4 — Troubled Waters
Columbo's Mexico cruise is disrupted when an automobile executive kills his blackmailing lover, the ship's singer, then frames a musician.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E5 — Playback
After killing his mother-in-law, an electronics magnate's alibi is a video security system.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E6 — A Deadly State of Mind
A psychiatrist (George Hamilton) romances a wealthy patient (Lesley Ann Warren) then uses her in his alibi after killing her husband (Stephen Elliott).

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E1 — Forgotten Lady
A retired actress/dancer stages her wealthy husband's suicide after he refuses to finance her Broadway comeback.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E4 — A Matter of Honor
A retired bullfighter credited with saving a young man from a bull arranges the death of the boy's father to protect his own reputation.

title: Columbo
description:
S6 E2 — Old-Fashioned Murder
The curator (Joyce Van Patten) of a strapped family-owned museum stages a robbery, for insurance, then murders to hide her crime; guests Celeste Holm, Tim O'Connor.
